adaptations: Remove constructor .to('cuda'); use parent model device
initialization: Author detector Conv2d weight normal_(0,0.02); keep default biases
active_scheme: B: redesigned feature-space adaptation, not the original paper architecture

scheme_b.input: Post-block patch tokens from ViT layers 4, 6, 8; normalized and projected to 192 channels
scheme_b.fen: Shared seven-convolution concatenation topology on 16x8, 8x4 and 4x2 grids; signed feature output
scheme_b.safa: Eight-group scale selection using pooled fine/middle queries and keys on the coarse grid
differences_from_original: Feature-space normalization and projection replace the RGB input
Pool by 2 and 4 for small patch grids instead of RGB stride-4 and stride-8 pyramid
Bias-free replication-padded convolutions replace zero-padded RGB convolutions
Single signed feature residual replaces eight RGB tanh residual groups
CLS-conditioned cosine attention reads centered patch values; equal mean across depths
Add fixed-gain norm-matched compensation to the equal CLS9-12 mean before BNNeck
scheme_b.training: Joint end-to-end from epoch 1, final ID + Triplet; no frozen active backbone or region partition
